If you're an Apple user who's taken tons of Live Photos on your iPhone, only to find them frozen into still images when you switch to Windows or an Android phone — don't worry, you've come to the right place. I want every vivid memory to stay just as alive, no matter which device you're viewing it on.

在这里，你可以自由地合成、拆分和修复实况照片。Apple 为优化前置拍摄性能，将实况视频的物理像素横向存储，依赖内置 Rotation 标签来判断画面方向——但 Windows 系统会忽略这个标签直接渲染原始像素，导致画面旋转；iOS 17.3 之前还存在缩略图拉伸的问题。Live Photo Box 通过底层物理级矫正，彻底根治这些跨平台兼容性顽疾。 合成与拆分也同样拿手：任意图片 + 视频 → 标准实况照片，适配 Google、OPPO、小米等 Android 实况协议；无损提取原始素材，完整保留 EXIF 与拍摄参数。此外，封面更换功能即将上线，照片自动分类等更多智能特性也在规划中，敬请期待。

Here, you can freely combine, split, and repair Live Photos. To optimize front-facing camera performance, Apple stores Live Photo video pixels horizontally, relying on a built-in Rotation tag to determine the correct orientation — but Windows ignores this tag and renders the raw pixels directly, causing the image to appear rotated. Prior to iOS 17.3, there was also a thumbnail stretching issue. Live Photo Box fixes these at the physical pixel level, thoroughly resolving these cross-platform compatibility problems. It's just as capable at combining and splitting: any image + video → a standard Live Photo, compatible with Google, OPPO, Xiaomi, and other Android Live Photo protocols; losslessly extract the original photo and video, preserving all EXIF data and capture parameters. Additionally, the cover change feature is coming soon, with more intelligent features like auto photo categorization also on the roadmap. Stay tuned!

1. 多余缩略图及横向拉伸（iOS 17.3 之前）： Apple 曾嵌入低分辨率缩略图来改善兼容性，但该缩略图带有方向标签，Windows 误将其当作横图处理，导致缩略图被异常拉宽或压扁。 iOS 17.3 起已不再内嵌。通过 jpegtran 无损旋转并剥离残留缩略图即可修复。
2. 前摄实况照片的视频部分画面会旋转： iPhone 前置摄像头将纵向像素横向存储，依赖方向标签指示正确显示角度，但 Windows 并不识别此标签。通过 FFmpeg 重编码即可修正。

Stretched Thumbnail with Extra Embedded Data (pre‑iOS 17.3): Apple embedded a low-resolution thumbnail for compatibility, but it carried an orientation tag that Windows misinterpreted as landscape, causing the thumbnail to be stretched or squished. iOS 17.3 and later no longer embed this data.
